title: str.split()
summary: Split a string into a list of substrings.
description: With no separator, splits on runs of any whitespace and discards empty results — which is almost always what you want for prose. With an explicit separator, consecutive separators produce empty strings.

parameters.name: sep
parameters.description: Delimiter. None means split on any whitespace run.

parameters.name: maxsplit
parameters.description: Maximum number of splits; -1 means no limit.

real_world_usage: Parsing log lines, splitting `KEY=VALUE` pairs (always with maxsplit=1), tokenising text.

common_mistakes.fix: Breaks on any quoted field containing a comma. Use the csv module.

common_mistakes.mistake: Expecting `'a  b'.split(' ')` to give two items
common_mistakes.fix: It gives `['a', '', 'b']`. Omit the separator to collapse whitespace.

performance_notes: Linear in the length of the string. For a single split, `partition()` is faster and returns a fixed-size tuple.
